units.text: It reads PDF documents, creates new ones, modifies existing content, and converts between formats. It exposes classes such as Aspose.Pdf.Document, Aspose.Pdf.Annotations, Aspose.Pdf.Text, Aspose.Pdf.Tagged, Aspose.Pdf.LogicalStructure, Aspose.Pdf.Comparison, Aspose.Pdf.PageCollection, Aspose.Pdf.OutlineCollection, Aspose.Pdf.PageLabelCollection, Aspose.Pdf.NamedDestinationCollection, Aspose.Pdf.XmpMetadata, Aspose.Pdf.OptionalContentGroup, Aspose.Pdf.TextStamp, Aspose.Pdf.Forms, Aspose.Pdf.AcroFormData, Aspose.Pdf.ExportFieldsToJsonOptions, Aspose.Pdf.Devices, Aspose.Pdf.SvgSaveOptions, Aspose.Pdf.RenderingOptions, Aspose.Pdf.Security, Aspose.Pdf.Signatures, Aspose.Pdf.CryptoAlgorithm, Aspose.Pdf.AutoTaggingSettings, Aspose.Pdf.SignaturesCompromiseDetector, Aspose.Pdf.Sanitization, and Aspose.Pdf.Facades to handle these operations.

It creates and manipulates PDF documents through the Aspose.Pdf.Document class, which provides access to page collections via Aspose.Pdf.PageCollection, outline collections via Aspose.Pdf.OutlineCollection, page label collections via Aspose.Pdf.PageLabelCollection, named destination collections via Aspose.Pdf.NamedDestinationCollection, XMP metadata via Aspose.Pdf.XmpMetadata, and optional content groups via Aspose.Pdf.OptionalContentGroup.
It handles text content and stamps using Aspose.Pdf.Text and Aspose.Pdf.TextStamp, enabling insertion, modification, and extraction of text elements within PDF pages.
It processes interactive forms through Aspose.Pdf.Forms and Aspose.Pdf.AcroFormData, supporting field access and export of form data to JSON using Aspose.Pdf.ExportFieldsToJsonOptions.

It renders pages and exports content to raster and vector formats using Aspose.Pdf.Devices, with rendering controlled by Aspose.Pdf.RenderingOptions and SVG export configured via Aspose.Pdf.SvgSaveOptions.
It secures documents and applies digital signatures using Aspose.Pdf.Security and Aspose.Pdf.Signatures, with encryption algorithms specified via Aspose.Pdf.CryptoAlgorithm.
It creates and manages tagged PDF structures for accessibility using Aspose.Pdf.Tagged and Aspose.Pdf.LogicalStructure, with tagging behavior configured via Aspose.Pdf.AutoTaggingSettings.
It compares documents, sanitizes content, and detects compromised signatures using Aspose.Pdf.Comparison, Aspose.Pdf.Sanitization, and Aspose.Pdf.SignaturesCompromiseDetector.
It provides high-level tools through Aspose.Pdf.Facades for common operations such as signing, flattening, and page manipulation without requiring direct interaction with low-level PDF structures.

Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET provides the Document class as its primary entry point, which exposes page content through PageCollection, interactive forms through Forms, and security features through Security and Signatures. The library targets netstandard2.0;net8.0;net9.0;net10.0;net4.8 and is version 26.10.0.

The Document class represents a PDF document and provides access to its pages via PageCollection, interactive outlines via OutlineCollection, page labels via PageLabelCollection, named destinations via NamedDestinationCollection, optional content groups via OptionalContentGroup, and XMP metadata via XmpMetadata.
The Text class supports text manipulation operations, and TextStamp enables adding text watermarks or stamps to PDF pages.
The Forms class provides access to interactive form fields, AcroFormData exposes form field data, and ExportFieldsToJsonOptions controls how form data is exported to JSON.
The Devices namespace provides rendering capabilities through classes like SvgSaveOptions and RenderingOptions for converting PDF pages to SVG and other formats.
The Security class handles document encryption, Signatures supports digital signing operations, and CryptoAlgorithm defines encryption algorithms such as AESx256.
The Tagged namespace supports tagged PDF features, LogicalStructure provides access to the document's logical structure tree, and AutoTaggingSettings controls automatic tagging behavior.
The Comparison namespace enables PDF comparison operations, SignaturesCompromiseDetector identifies compromised signatures, and Sanitization removes sensitive content from documents.
The Facades namespace provides high-level facade classes for common PDF operations such as signing, flattening, and page manipulation.

Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET reads and writes PDF, converts to HTML, SVG, Markdown, plain text, XML, and PostScript, and supports text extraction, form filling, signing, encryption, and page-to-image rendering with PngDevice, JpegDevice, BmpDevice, and TiffDevice through the managed SoftwarePageRenderer on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
AI-assisted workflows and one-call low-code façades are out of scope by design, and there are no dedicated multithreading APIs; this edition is single-threaded for a single Document instance.
Format converters are limited to PDF, HTML, SVG, Markdown, plain text, XML, and PostScript; DOCX, EPUB, MHT, XPS, PCL, LaTeX, DJVU, OFD, and CGM conversion are not included.

Members that take or return System.Drawing images — ImageDevice.GetBitmap, StampInfo.Image, XImage.Grayscaled, FigureElement.Image, TextBoxField.AddImage, the ImagesDifference bitmaps, and the hOCR Document.Convert callbacks — are Windows-only and throw PlatformNotSupportedException on Linux/macOS.

Signing and verification work, but OCSP and CRL revocation checks are not implemented: asking for them through ValidationOptions.ValidationMethod reports the result as undefined, failing the verification only in Strict mode.

Rendering is not pixel-identical across platforms: the managed renderer used off Windows and the GDI+ one on Windows can differ slightly in sub-pixel glyph positioning, image dithering and anti-aliasing weight.
DocumentCollection.GetEnumerator() is not yet implemented and throws NotImplementedException.
ActivationEvent represents the event that triggers the activation of an annotation.
ContentType specifies the MIME type of the content associated with an annotation.
FixedPrint defines the fixed print settings for an annotation, including horizontal and vertical translation and a transformation matrix.
MarkupAnnotation is a base class for markup annotations that support properties such as appearance, author, color, contents, flags, and state.
SoundData holds the audio data used by sound annotations.
SoundEncoding indicates the encoding format of the sound data in a sound annotation.
SoundIcon specifies the icon displayed for a sound annotation.
SoundSampleDataEncodingFormat defines the encoding format for sound sample data.
UriAction represents an action that opens a Uniform Resource Identifier.
BorderPartStyle describes the style of a border part for an annotation.
DocumentCollection manages a collection of documents within the Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET library.
IFacade is an interface that defines the contract for facade classes in the facades namespace.
ISaveableFacade is an interface that extends IFacade and adds the capability to save the facade's state.
PdfPrintPageInfo provides information about a page for printing purposes.
ChoiceField represents a form field that allows users to select from a list of options.
HtmlBorderLineType specifies the line type used for borders in HTML content.
IWarningCallback defines a callback interface for handling warnings during PDF processing.
ImageFilterType indicates the filter used for image processing.
LaunchActionOperation specifies the operation to perform when launching an external application.
LaunchActionOperationConverter provides functionality to convert launch action operations.
AnnotElement represents an annotation element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
ArtElement represents an art element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
BibEntryElement represents a bibliographic entry element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
BlockQuoteElement represents a block quote element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
CaptionElement represents a caption element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
CodeElement represents a code element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
DivElement represents a division element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
FormulaElement represents a formula element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
IndexElement represents an index element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
ListLBodyElement represents the body of a list item in the logical structure of a PDF document.
ListLblElement represents the label of a list item in the logical structure of a PDF document.
NonStructElement represents a non-structural element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
PartElement represents a part element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
PrivateElement represents a private element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
ReferenceElement represents a reference element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
RubyElement represents a ruby annotation element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
RubyRBElement represents the ruby base text element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
RubyRPElement represents the ruby parenthesis element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
RubyRTElement represents the ruby text element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
WarichuElement represents a warichu annotation element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
WarichuWPElement represents a Japanese warichu paragraph element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
WarichuWTElement represents a Japanese warichu text element in the logical structure of a PDF document.
NodeLevelResourceType specifies the type of resource associated with a node in the logical structure tree.
PdfAStandardVersion indicates the PDF/A standard version used for a document.
Permissions defines the set of operations allowed on a PDF document.
PixelFormat describes the pixel format used for image processing operations.
PrintScaling specifies how page scaling is handled during printing.
ProgressEventHandlerInfo provides information about the progress of a long-running operation.
ResourceLoadingResult indicates the outcome of loading an external resource.
ResourceSavingInfo contains information about saving a resource during export.
ReturnAction defines the action performed when returning from a destination in a PDF document.
Rotation specifies the rotation angle applied to a page or content.
SvgImageSavingInfo provides information about saving an SVG image during export.
TableBroken indicates whether a table is broken across pages.
OriginalFontSpecification describes the original font used for text in a PDF document.
WarningInfo contains details about a warning generated during PDF processing.
